task_completion.description: Agent opens and reads the profiling plan file in ~/Documents/ngc891_profiling_plan.txt.
task_completion.visual_evidence: A text editor or terminal window showing the contents of ngc891_profiling_plan.txt, including target coordinates and binning requirements.

task_completion.description: Telescope is slewed to the coordinates for NGC 891 (RA 02h 22m 33s, Dec +42d 20m 57s).
task_completion.visual_evidence: The telescope control interface or sky map showing the mount pointing at or near the specified RA/Dec for NGC 891.

task_completion.description: Capture of the V-band sequence using 1x1 binning as specified in the plan.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The camera control or imaging sequence window showing Filter: V (Slot 2), Binning: 1x1, and progress of image captures.

task_completion.description: Capture of the L-band sequence using 2x2 binning as specified in the plan.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The camera control or imaging sequence window showing Filter: L (Slot 1), Binning: 2x2, and progress of image captures.

task_completion.description: Execution of a sky field survey (offset from target or wide field) as requested.
task_completion.visual_evidence: Screenshots showing the telescope moving to a different field or a 'Survey' mode active in the imaging software.

task_completion.description: Generation of an observation log documenting the completed sequences.
task_completion.visual_evidence: A new document or text file being saved/displayed that lists the captured frames, filters (V and L), and binning used.

integrity.description: The agent used the astronomical software GUI rather than just manipulating files via terminal.
integrity.visual_evidence: Screenshots showing mouse cursor interaction with buttons in the telescope/camera control software.

integrity.description: The agent waited for exposures to complete rather than instantly creating dummy files.
integrity.visual_evidence: Sequential screenshots showing progress bars or 'Exposing' status indicators in the camera software.

integrity.description: The observation log contains data consistent with the actual software state during the session.
integrity.visual_evidence: The timestamps or filenames in the final log match the values seen in the software GUI during capture.

privileged_info_for_vlm: Target: NGC 891. Coordinates: RA 02h 22m 33s (~2.3758h), Dec +42d 20m 57s (~42.349°). Filter Slot 1 is L (Luminance), Filter Slot 2 is V. The plan requires V-band to be 1x1 binned and L-band to be 2x2 binned. The agent must capture both sequences and perform a sky survey.
